plan.title: The masterplan
plan.intro: These are early ideas for the town centre and nothing is fixed yet. Pick a layer to read more, or tap the plan to leave a comment.

layers.label: New homes
layers.details:
Around 400 new homes in a mix of family houses and apartments, set around shared gardens.

About a third would be affordable homes, split between shared ownership and social rent. The tallest buildings sit next to the station and step down towards the older terraces.

layers.label: Workspace and shops
layers.details:
Offices and studios next to the station, with shops and cafes at street level along the high street.

Smaller units are planned for local and independent businesses.

layers.label: Parks and public spaces
layers.details:
A new market square and park in the middle of the town, with trees, seating and space for a weekly market and events.

Pocket gardens link the square to the riverside.

layers.label: Walking and cycling routes
layers.details: A riverside path for walking and cycling, safer crossings on the main road and a clear route from the station to the high street.

points.title: Market Square
points.text: A new public square and park at the heart of the scheme, with trees, seating and space for markets and events.

points.title: High Street
points.text: Shops and cafes at street level, wider pavements and fewer cars along the main street.

points.title: Station Gateway
points.text: Offices and workspace next to the station, with a clearer walking route into the town centre.

points.title: Riverside Walk
points.text: A continuous path along the river for walking and cycling, with planting and places to stop.

points.title: Mill Lane homes
points.text: A mix of family houses and apartments, including affordable homes, around shared gardens.
